text_blocks.snippet: "Cancer de medula" can refer to several different types of cancer, but it most commonly refers to medullary thyroid cancer (MTC), which originates in the thyroid gland. It can also refer to renal medullary carcinoma (RMC), a rare and aggressive kidney cancer, or bone marrow cancer. Additionally, it could refer to other cancers that involve the bone marrow or spine.
